name: gate from comparison and logical operators
description: A 100 V chopper whose switch is closed while the sine wave x (amplitude 1, 50 Hz) lies between 0.3 and 0.8: the gate is the expression (x > 0.3) && (x < 0.8), 1 while true and 0 otherwise. The load is 1 mH with 10 ohm and a freewheeling diode. With "switching": "interpolated" (the default of version 0.10) the switch acts where x crosses the band, between grid points (see events.csv): it closes at asin(0.3)/(2 pi 50) = 0.969867 ms and opens at asin(0.8)/(2 pi 50) = 2.951672 ms, closes again at 7.048328 ms and opens at 9.030133 ms, every 20 ms. The same gate written with sign and abs, (sign(x - 0.3) + abs(sign(x - 0.3)))/2 for x > 0.3 and abs(sign(p))*abs(sign(q)) for p && q, or with two comparators and a product, gives the same result byte for byte.
